text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp began once again this 
year. Echoing throughout the bus heading 
to the camp was—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, you've been noisy for a while 
now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho, who had voiced her 
complaints, was currently in a 
rehabilitation period due to an injury. It 
seemed she had joined the summer training 
camp as part of her recovery.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Buuut I'm just way too excited for the 
upcoming Sapporo Kinen~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like ice cream and melons and stuff♡ And 
it'll definitely be cool and comfy♡

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, Grandma told me that even in 
Sapporo, it gets pretty hot in August!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If you take it too lightly, you're gonna 
take a tumble, so watch out.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. I'll teach you a magic spell to 
cool down! Hold out both hands!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's a magic spray brewed with peppermint! 
Feel that cool, refreshing chill?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Alright, I'll let you borrow it, 
just this once. ...Not like I can run much 
this summer anyway.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm going out of my way to lend it to you, 
so you better go out there and win, got 
it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our third summer training camp 
began!
